facts.fact: At the Council of Ministers of 11 March 2026 the Minister of the Interior presented a note on a draft decree for the Agence nationale de l'état civil (ANEC); the decree was not adopted, with further reflection, awareness work and attention to national sovereignty recommended before any final adoption.
